youtube.baslik: How can a word be made easier for a child to hear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Acoustic highlighting means making the target word or sound easier for the child to hear: the target word is said with a little more stress, a little longer and with more melody, after a short pause. Placing the target word at the end of the sentence also adds emphasis, because the last word is the easiest to remember. As the child progresses, highlighting is reduced; the aim is for the child to understand everyday speech at a natural pace.
